steps.content: The entire space seems to have frozen.
The customers who ran out and the owner in the store are frozen in place like statues, unable to move.
Eleven shook everything up after uttering that refusal in her own voice, and everything, in the end, fell back into silence.
But you know that something is on the brink of derangement. You must...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Get out of here right now!!!
You feel the force that had been restraining you suddenly vanish. You quickly pull Nino and Eleven towards the exit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eleven was indeed the key to cracking this world! But now the world is collapsing. We must find a place to escape or hide from this wave of derangement!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Huh?! How... how can we find such a place so quickly?!
As you speak, you see the wall behind the record store beginning to display eerie signal failures, accompanied by crackling static. These anomalies gradually cover the entire wall.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Holy ****! It's really starting!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're running out of time...
Hahaha...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who's there?!
A shrill laugh suddenly rings out around you. The familiar tone makes Eleven instinctively grip your sleeve tightly.
You look towards the source of the sound... it's the owner's radio.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: It's very close. I can hear the voice I've been seeking for a long time. It's my favorite sound!

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: You finally found your own voice. Are you happy? But... do you really know how to use it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She has spoken already, so surely she will remember. Don't think about controlling her.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Don't jump to conclusions... Allow me to congratulate you first for successfully leaving this world~

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: But... it's not enough... Can you find more?

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: You will help me find them. You're different from the rest...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: More? You never intended to let us go back, did you?!

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Come... Remember where you started your journey?

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: I will personally... come to see you...
The familiar voice disappears, and the record player's indicator light goes out. The outage spreads instantly before your eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Get out first! Hurry!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Can't we take the owner with us?"

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's part of this world... I don't know if taking her is the right thing for either us or her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In my opinion, we should prioritize the safety of us three.
Eleven glances at you, then at the owner who's still in the store, and types rapidly on her device.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Thank you!!! When this is all over, I will definitely come see you. This time, I'll keep my word!!"

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hmm... ah!!
After Eleven utters the only sound she can make, she turns around to catch up to you.
Zigzagging sound waves appear from under her feet the moment she speaks again. They wrap around the record store owner and vanish into thin air.

steps.speaker: Record Store Owner
steps.content: "Thank you, and also... I'm sorry. But I'll always remember why you chose this path... Please don't forget what you've loved in the first place... the sound of Call at 3 AM..."
Eleven looks back again, but she can no longer find the source of the voice.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Wait, where are we going? Are we just running out randomly?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To the phone booth on Fifth Avenue!
